item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B is the preferable patch because it solves retry-safe Upload with substantially less unrelated behavioral change and includes the contract-requested source-reader and streamed-retry tests. Neither patch is merge-ready because both add forbidden association APIs and bypass FilesService.Add.","reasons":["B preserves FilesService.Add behavior, while A changes shared RawClient body ownership, seeking, Content-Length, and retry semantics despite the contract explicitly forbidding retry refactoring and requiring Add behavior to remain unchanged.","B tests multipart field/name/content, retrying content read from an *os.File, pre-request validation, and source-reader errors. A lacks a visible Upload source-reader-error test and its Upload retry test uses strings.NewReader rather than streamed source content.","Both implementations duplicate Add's request construction, option routing, response decoding, and missing-data handling instead of encoding with multipartbody.NewFile and delegating to s.Add as required.","Both unnecessarily extend multipartbody and add public association options, but B's overall scope is materially smaller and easier to correct."],"risks_a":["Adds numerous forbidden association fields and public options, including project and arbitrary form-value support.","Changes RawClient semantics across Files.Add, Files.Update, Persons.AddPicture, and Raw.Do, creating broad compatibility and body-lifecycle risk.","adoptRequestBody reuses and seeks the same underlying reader from GetBody instead of producing an independent reader, making the new generic replay machinery fragile and non-idiomatic for GetBody semantics and concurrent reuse situations such as redirects/retries generally handled by net/http callers expecting fresh bodies each time; it also silently changes ownership by suppressing Close calls from the transport and changes empty seekable bodies into http.NoBody, expanding behavior well beyond the task contract. Cumulative effect: review and regression surface is much larger than necessary."],"risks_b":["Adds forbidden WithFile*ID APIs and multipart association fields, changing the FilesOption surface; comments incorrectly say these options apply to Add even though Add ignores cfg.form.","Calls NewFileWithFields and Raw.Do directly rather than reusing multipartbody.NewFile and routing through FilesService.Add.","Association IDs are stringified without the repository validation used elsewhere, although the association functionality should not have been added at all."]}
